title: Research: quantify the historical U8/T37 integer-replica moment gap
body:
The historical U8/T37 equality obstruction admits a quantitative integer refinement: when 37 does not divide the positive replica count T, the normalized moment gap is strictly greater than 29/(313958400*T). The package independently reconstructs the rank-credit table, proves the all-T congruence argument, and checks rational supporting intervals, all 37 residue classes and five assumption controls. Jonathan Capalbo and Chafik Boukhalfa retain credit for the underlying T37 and signed-dual results.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/975f5ae3057f53627f6bce1764d0f994cfc9b35c/research/t37-integer-slack-audit/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
